x: Jack Shotter, now a Captain in command of an Indian training establishment, with 800 to keep an eye on. Sends a most interesting letter—hockey, hunting wild animals, and showing a clean pair of heels to the Sepoys.
Jack Shotter has been taking a crack at the Japs in Burma. Played some Rugger and had enough wind left (thanks to his C.-C. training) to run back to the lines.

Frank Elson, after his strenuous time with the R.E.M.E., had a spell in hospital for shock, but is now better again—in fact, he looked in at the Hall a short time ago and looked bronzed and very fit. Jack Shotter. The latest news is that he is now in the fighting in Burma.

Frank Abberton writes to us from Sydney, Australia, where he has been enjoying some surf-riding. Jack Shotter is now at Singapore, having come from Ceylon. He is pleased to read of the Club's successes and sends his best wishes to all.
Jack Shotter, who has recently returned from India, is now in regular training at Belgrave Hall.
Tween showed an improvement on recent form, and we thank J.

Stokell on the birth of a daughter and if we get many more female additions to the club strength, we shall have to consider starting a ladies' section, shades of Footer! Jack Shotter, Captain in the Regular Army, is now in Middle East and sends best wishes to all his friends at " Belgrave Hall."
